name: xml
reason: README claims only design properties ('very fast to build DOM-like tree structure' because it does not recurse and allocates only for tokens, 'doesn't alloc memory for keys and values only for tokens') with no timing, memory figure or baseline named; the README's own TODO leaves tests, documentation and 'extra optimizations' unchecked. Repo page (18 stars, MIT, last commit 2026-06-17, 92 commits; root has include/xml, src, win, CMake and autotools files, no benchmark or test directory) has two issues (#3 whitespace handling, #4 invalid condition), neither about speed. Not among the 43 libraries of miloyip/nativejson-benchmark (JSON only); WebSearch for recp/xml benchmarks against libxml2, expat, pugixml or rapidxml found no third-party timings.
